The '''Unfyr''' were an ancient warrior culture of the [[Ka'hren]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on [[V'shar]].<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

The Unfyr warriors were adept in the use of the [[rantok]] traditional sword, and they worshiped a minor god of war and wisdom named [[Ni'Shaw]].<ref name="air" />

The Unfyr people rejected the use of blasters as an alternative to the rantok, which was one of the reasons that led to their extinction.<ref name="air" />

After their fall, both their god and their weapon were forgotten until their rediscovery centuries later by [[Kaltor Naklian]].<ref name="air" />
